evidence.observation: O2 rose monotonically from ~3 ppm to 32 ppm during growth (k=21..25) despite steady Ar flow and pressure
Ar flow stable at ~100 sccm, so rise is not a purge-gas loss

args.missing_evidence: Whether O2 keeps climbing (leak) or plateaus/decays; a flow-step or pressure-hold leak check would discriminate air ingress from a transient outgassing event.
